 Help us build the world's most reliable, on\-demand logistics engine for last\-mile delivery! **About The Role**
 We are looking for experienced engineers to join the Traffic team and help build the next generation of DoorDash’s Traffic platform. Our team develops and operates the critical traffic infrastructure that powers communication between thousands of services across multiple regions, as well as the ingress systems that handle external traffic entering the DoorDash platform.
   

  

 You will work on core components of our traffic stack, including the Envoy Data Plane, xDS control planes and proxyless architecture. This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and large\-scale infrastructure. This role includes designing, building, and maintaining systems that must operate reliably and efficiently across some of the most critical and latency\-sensitive workloads at DoorDash.
   

  

 You will report to the Engineering Manager of the Traffic Team within the Infrastructure organization. This role is hybrid working from one of our engineering hubs based in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle or New York
   

  

**You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…**
* Design and build large\-scale distributed systems that are high RPS and latency sensitive
* Troubleshoot, debug, and fix issues that affect production and maintain our SLAs
* Work collaboratively with other platform and product engineers to deliver on feature requests and solve their problems
* Find ways to improve the team’s productivity and operational capabilities through the use of automation, AI tools, and other avenues
* Participate in a shared on\-call and support rotation and lead production investigations and incidents


**We’re Excited About You Because…**
* You have 5\+ years of experience as a software engineer in infrastructure, networking, or platform engineering.
* Experience with Programming Languages like Go, C\+\+, Python or Rust
* Experience with AWS and Kubernetes
* Background working on and debugging high\-QPS or latency\-sensitive systems
* You are curious, independent, ambitious, and can find solutions and make progress in an ambiguous and challenging environment
* You have proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software


**Bonus points if you…**
* Experience with service mesh technologies such as Envoy, Istio or Linkerd
* Familiarity with xDS or control plane architectures
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals like TCP/IP, HTTP, HTTP/2, gRPC, Load Balancing
* Experience building RPC frameworks or client\-side networking libraries
* Experience with AWS Networking Primitives like Load Balancers, Privatelink, etc.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling like Terraform
* Experience with Gitops delivery tooling such as ArgoCD, Helm, Atlantis.

**About The Team**
 DoorDash Labs, established in 2018, serves as the innovation hub for DoorDash, focusing on developing automation and robotics solutions to enhance last\-mile logistics. The team's mission is to create technologies that support and augment human networks, aiming to improve efficiency for Dashers, merchants, and consumers alike. We’re ruthlessly focused on business impact. We are a highly senior team composed of former pioneers from a variety of different robotics industries. As of 2025, DoorDash has completed 10B lifetime deliveries. We’re focused on how to do the next 10B even better.
   

  

 The DoorDash Air team is bringing drone delivery to reality. To make this happen, we’re building a strong electrical team to design high reliability, high power density converters, and fault\-tolerant controls electronics. Come join us to build a new class of aircrafts and deploy at scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to lead the development and bring\-up of ARM\-based microcontroller platforms across our robotics products. This is a high\-ownership role, directly responsible for building the low\-level firmware that powers our platforms. You will design, implement, and validate firmware for motion control, sensor integration, communications, power management, and safety\-critical functionality. This role comes with a strong expectation of hands\-on board bring\-up, low\-level debugging, and cross\-disciplinary collaboration with electrical and systems engineers.
   

  

**You're Excited About This Opportunity Because...**
* Own the firmware bring\-up and integration for new embedded platforms (e.g. ARM Cortex\-M series).
* Develop and maintain bare\-metal firmware and RTOS\-based applications for robotic subsystems (motor control, sensors, telemetry, power systems).
* Write and maintain robust, maintainable, and well\-documented C/C\+\+ code for embedded targets.
* Collaborate with the electrical engineering team on hardware bring\-up, schematic review, and system integration.
* Lead system bringup, validation, and debug
* Contribute to firmware safety, reliability, and system\-level robustness.


 We're excited about you because...
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in embedded systems development.
* Deep expertise in bare\-metal programming on ARM microcontrollers.
* Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded targets and firmware design patterns.
* Experience with hardware bring\-up and low\-level debugging on custom boards.
* Solid understanding of digital electronics, buses (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN), and embedded peripherals.
* Strong system\-level thinking, with an ability to work independently and take ownership across the full development cycle.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) or Embedded Linux on constrained systems.
* Familiarity with motor control, power systems, or battery management in robotics or automotive contexts.
* Experience working closely with hardware teams, reading schematics, and performing board\-level debug.
* Familiarity with safety\-critical systems, watchdogs, and fault handling.
* Comfortable working in fast\-paced, high\-ownership engineering environments like those found in startups or advanced R\&D teams

WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI\-driven data economy.
   

  





 As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.
   

  





 We combine deep engineering expertise with global\-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.
   

  





 This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.
   

  





 We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.
   

  





 Join us and let’s shape the future of data.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Build the AI\-powered tools that WD's engineers actually use every day. You'll own full\-stack features end\-to\-end — from UI to database to AI/ML components — and your work will directly shape how next\-gen storage devices are designed, tested, and manufactured.
   

  





**What you'll build** 
 :
   

  




* AI features and automation workflows embedded in production engineering apps


* RAG\-based pipelines and LLM integrations across tools like ADAM, WDFA, LIMS, and DRVM


* New tooling for monitoring HDD product telemetry data in real time


* Reusable AI/ML patterns deployable across the full DRI Tools portfolio


* Full\-stack components spanning UI, REST APIs, backend services, and data layers



**Tech Stack** 
 :
   

  





 Language: Python. AI/ML: LLMs, RAG Pipeline, Llama.cpp, Hugging Face, text embeddings, AI Harness (eg Claude Code) Front End: Web Apps: React, Tailwind CC, Vite APIs: REST API design \& development Data: SQL/MySQL, data pipelines, file I/O, text parsing Devops: Git/Bitbucket, CI/CD, JIRA, Agile/Scrum
   

  

 Platforms: Linux, Mac, Windows
   

  





**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**



* Design, develop, test, and ship software tools — web, desktop, and CLI — in a large\-scale enterprise engineering environment
* Own features from requirements → code → deployment
* Evaluate and integrate LLMs and embedding models into existing applications
* Build and expand automation and telemetry monitoring platforms


* Write clean, well\-tested, maintainable Python code aligned to team standards


* Collaborate directly with HDD R\&D and product engineering stakeholders to scope and ship solutions that reduce manual effort


* Stay current on open\-source AI tooling and emerging frameworks

* Currently pursuing a BS degree in Computer Science or a related field.

* Experience with REST API design and development


* Familiarity with SQL/MySQL and data pipeline development


* Understanding of AI/ML concepts — LLMs, embeddings, or RAG architectures


* Experience with version control and CI/CD workflows (Git/Bitbucket)


* Ability to work across the full stack: UI, API layer, database, and AI/ML components



**Nice to have** 
 :
   

  




* Hands\-on experience with AI frameworks and Harnesses


* Prior exposure to engineering or manufacturing software environments


* Experience with Agile/Scrum development practices


* Familiarity with telemetry data monitoring or failure analysis tooling

**Description**
 Are you seeking an opportunity to implement novel analytic process and methods that improve acquisition program cost and schedule execution?
   

  

 Are you motivated by taking disparate data sources and building structured analytic frameworks that support important resource allocation decisions?
   

  

 If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!
   

  

 We are seeking an Acquisition Data Scientist to help develop next\-generation project management cost and schedule control techniques across the full data science pipeline in support of DoW / US Govt. Sponsors. Significant tasks will include the collection, pre\-processing, normalization, statistical analysis, and development operations (e.g., DevOps) of financial and parametric data in order to generate credible cost and schedule estimates.
   

  

 You'll be joining a hardworking team of analysts who incorporate affordability and cost considerations into the critical solutions to the critical challenges our nation faces. As a member of our team, you will contribute to network\-based schedule risk assessments, trade space studies (e.g., Analysis of Alternatives, Business Case Analyses, Economic Analyses), affordability studies (e.g., Life Cycle Cost Estimates, Total Ownership Costs), and earned value management (EVM) forecasting.
   

  

**As an Affordability Analyst/Acquisition Data Scientist, you will...**
* Be responsible for aggregating cost and parametric data of government projects through both structured (DAMIR, CADE, VAMOSC, USASpending.gov) and unstructured (open\-source web website, LLMs, domain expert interviews) research in order to improve upon existing or generate new and innovative cost estimating relationships.
* Contribute to studies that quantify best value assessments through affordability analysis, decision frameworks, data visualization, sensitivity analysis, and data management.
* Learn to build cost and schedule estimates integrating statistical analysis, network science, modeling \& simulation (M\&S), cost databases, and expert opinion in Excel, MATLAB, Python, R, and cost estimating software (e.g., ACEIT and Price Trueplanning).
* Design, implement, and operationalize data operations (DataOps) pipelines that support scalable, and reliable data analytics across defense acquisition programs.
* Collaborate with APL staff from all sectors and departments on technical studies across land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace domains.


**Qualifications**
**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...**
* Have a Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, mathematics, engineering, operations research, or a related field.
* Have proven experience organizing data into flexible, scalable, and reusable structures, performing comprehensive data analysis, and establishing data management frameworks.
* Have proficient software programming capabilities in Python and SQL.
* Have knowledge of at least several statistical analysis and simulation packages (Python \[SciPy, iGraph, Statsmodels, PyMC, NumPY], R, Stata, SAS, JMP, MATLAB, @Risk etc.).
* Are able to obtain an Interim Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.


**You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...**
* Have a Master's degree, or Ph.D, in data science, business analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, mathematics, engineering, or operations research.
* Have proficient software programming capabilities in Java, JavaScript, and/or C\+\+
* Have a certification related to cost analysis (DAWIA or CCEA) and/or earned value management (EVMP)
* Have domain expertise in creating data analysis dashboards through Shiny, Python, JavaScript, CSS, Visual Basic, Tableau, etc.

**General Summary**
 Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G — ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5G's potential into world\-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age — and this is where you come in.
   

  

 The Modem Systems Software team builds the low\-level firmware and protocol software that powers cellular connectivity across billions of devices worldwide — spanning smartphones, automotive, IoT, fixed wireless access, and next\-generation 5G/6G platforms. We are re\-imagining how modem software is designed, built, verified, and maintained in an AI\-native paradigm, where large language models, agentic tooling, and machine\-assisted engineering are first\-class parts of the development lifecycle.
   

  

 As a Modem Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize real\-time embedded software for Qualcomm's modem subsystem (MPSS). You will work close to the metal — writing performant, resource\-constrained C/C\+\+ that runs on DSP and Arm cores across cellular protocol layers, device drivers, and RTOS\-level components.
   

  

 Beyond traditional embedded development, this role is explicitly
 **AI\-native** 
 . You are expected to leverage, build, and improve AI\-assisted development workflows — using code\-generation agents, LLM\-based code review, automated test synthesis, log/crash triage assistants, and retrieval\-augmented tooling over our codebase — to dramatically accelerate delivery, quality, and debugging in a highly complex firmware environment.
   

  

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, and optimize real\-time embedded modem software across protocol layers, drivers, and platform services, meeting strict latency, memory, and power constraints.
* Apply rigorous data\-structure and algorithm design to build efficient, scalable firmware components.
* Own end\-to\-end feature delivery: requirements, architecture, implementation, unit/integration testing, on\-target bring\-up, and maintenance.
* Pioneer AI\-native development practices within the team — integrate AI coding agents into daily workflows, establish agent rules and prompt patterns, and measurably reduce development and debug cycle time.
* Build and maintain AI\-assisted tooling for code review, static analysis, test synthesis, and automated crash/log triage over the modem codebase.
* Debug and root\-cause complex, multi\-layer issues on target hardware, increasingly leveraging AI\-assisted analysis of logs, traces, and RAM dumps.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with systems, hardware, test, and integration teams to deliver production\-quality modem firmware.
* Contribute to code reviews, design reviews, and continuous improvement of engineering standards — including standards for the responsible and effective use of AI in the SDLC.
* Mentor peers on both embedded fundamentals and AI\-native engineering techniques.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.


**Preferred Qualifications**
**Core Embedded \& Systems Engineering**
* Strong command of data structures and algorithms with the ability to reason about time/space complexity in memory\- and cycle\-constrained environments.
* Deep understanding of operating systems concepts: scheduling, concurrency, interrupts, memory management, IPC, real\-time constraints, and RTOS internals (e.g., QuRT, ThreadX, FreeRTOS, or similar).
* Proven programming proficiency in modern C/C\+\+ (C\+\+17 and beyond), including performance optimization, cache\-aware design, and lock\-free/thread\-safe patterns.
* Experience with embedded software on DSP and Arm architectures, including familiarity with SIMD/vectorization, DMA, and low\-power design.
* Experience with debugging on target hardware — JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, crash\-dump / RAM\-dump analysis, and log parsing.
* Familiarity with device drivers, HAL layers, boot flows, and hardware/software co\-design.


**AI\-Native Engineering**
* AI\-first mindset: you treat AI tooling as a core engineering multiplier, not an afterthought. You default to designing workflows where an AI agent does the first draft of code, tests, and analysis, and the engineer curates, validates, and hardens.
* Experience using AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cline, Claude/GPT\-based agents) to generate, refactor, and review embedded C/C\+\+ at scale.
* Ability to build and maintain AI\-augmented developer workflows: prompt libraries, agent rules, retrieval\-augmented context over large firmware codebases, and MCP\-style tool integrations.
* Experience applying LLMs to crash triage, log summarization, root\-cause analysis, and automated defect classification in complex embedded systems.
* Interest in AI\-assisted test generation and verification — synthesizing unit/integration tests, fuzzing harnesses, and coverage\-driven test expansion for modem software.
* Comfort evaluating AI output critically: understanding hallucination risks, validating generated code against timing/memory budgets, and enforcing safety and correctness in real\-time firmware.
* Bonus: experience fine\-tuning, prompt\-engineering, or building tooling around code models; familiarity with embedding/vector search over source repositories.

**About Melior** 




 Melior is an AI transformation firm built for the way business leaders actually want to adopt AI \- strategically, practically, and with measurable impact. We serve as the AI Transformation Partner for mid\-market companies, guiding them through the full adoption curve across two integrated pillars:
 


* **Workforce Adoption.** 
 We help companies build an AI\-first culture \- setting AI policy and tool selection, running enterprise\-wide training and upskilling, and driving the change management required to turn tool access into real, lasting behavior change.

 We engineer purpose\-built AI workflows and agents for our clients' highest\-value problems \- from discovery and roadmapping through custom development that integrates directly into their existing tech stack.



 What sets us apart for other players in our space is the combination of deep operational experience and real technical depth to build impactful AI solutions. 
 



  





 Melior is led by a team of proven operators and technologists who have built, scaled, and exited businesses across consulting, marketing services, and technology.
 


* Ryan Markman, CEO \- Former Bain consultant, experienced C\-suite operator with a previous business exit, and an AI product leader.
* Ken Baker, COO \- Two\-time CEO with 15\+ years leading large professional services businesses, including a marketing services firm he co\-founded, scaled and exited.
* Adrien Delessert, CTO \- Veteran CTO and software engineer across multiple venture\-backed companies, with deep expertise in ML and AI engineering.



 Joining Melior means working directly alongside a leadership team that has managed complex organizations, navigated real change management challenges, and built technical systems at scale. Now we’re applying all of it to the most consequential technology shift in business today.
 



  





**What You'll Be Doing** 




 As an AI Workflow Engineer, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and engagement leads to design, build, and ship the custom AI workflows and agents that power our client engagements. You’ll collaborate with clients at every level of their organization—from senior executives to frontline teams. Your day\-to\-day might involve:
 


* Meeting (virtually) with clients to deeply understand their current work processes, identify pain points, and assess ways AI could help.
* Designing, building, and shipping AI workflows and agents. Implementations range in complexity, such as
* Custom skills
* Low\-code automations in Zapier, n8n, or Make
* Custom\-developed agentic systems, built via Claude Code or Codex, and deployed on the Melior Nexus platform, which simplifies building, deploying and maintaining custom AI apps
* Working alongside client teams to test, refine, and measure these solutions to ensure they genuinely improve their work and create measurable efficiency gains.
* Documenting what you learn into straightforward playbooks and resources that we can reuse across future projects.
* Collaborating with AI Program managers and Melior leadership on executive level client meetings such as QBRs \& AI strategy presentations.
* Helping us evolve our offerings and processes \- as an early team member, your ideas and experiences will directly shape how we grow and the solutions we deliver.



  





 This role is perfect for someone who loves seeing immediate, tangible results from their work, has a strong desire to accelerate and master their capabilities with AI, and enjoys the satisfaction of solving diverse, real\-world business problems with technology.
 



  





 This is a hybrid role in Philadelphia, but we are open to remote work for the right candidate.
 



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 We think you'd be great for this role if you:
 


* Have spent 2\-5\+ years in roles like solutions engineering, software engineering, technical operations, internal tools, or automation in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. We’re looking for experience where you built real things, navigated ambiguity, juggled multiple priorities, and owned outcomes.
* Are confident and thoughtful in conversations at all levels of an organization, able to quickly build trust and understand people's genuine needs. Client services experience is a plus.
* Are genuinely excited about generative AI and have gotten your hands dirty building with it, whether that’s side projects, API experiments, vibe\-coding with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Lovable, or stitching together workflows in Zapier, n8n, or Make. This is a hard requirement; we want to see what you’ve built.

* Are organized and proactive—you're good at managing your own projects, deadlines, and client communications in a fast\-paced, small\-team environment.

**Why Join Melior?** 



* Real Impact: You’ll have a direct influence on the trajectory of our company. Your work and ideas will shape how Melior operates and grows.
* Accelerate AI Expertise: For our money, there’s no better way to accelerate your practical AI knowledge than to join Melior. You’ll go beyond theory to build real\-world solutions clients use immediately.

* Variety and Depth: You'll explore different industries and tackle a wide range of interesting, practical problems. One week might involve content workflows at a marketing agency, another could be streamlining sales processes at a SaaS firm.

 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

**Job Summary**
 The Delphi Software Engineer is responsible for maintaining and modernizing the legacy Delphi application portfolio while leading migration to the new target environment: Azure cloud\-native solutions built on C\# (Function Apps, App Services, Storage Accounts, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related services). This role keeps purpose\-built applications supporting health plan business capabilities running reliably while still re\-platforming for future utilization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Maintain, support, and troubleshoot the existing Delphi application portfolio, including both desktop and web\-based solutions, against Oracle and SQL Server databases.
* Lead modernization of Delphi applications to Azure cloud\-native solutions built on C\#, including redesign and redevelopment using Function Apps, App Services, Storage Accounts, Managed Identity, and Key Vault.
* Assess each legacy Delphi application's business logic, data dependencies, and integrations to design an appropriate cloud\-native replacement architecture.
* Develop migration plans that sequence and prioritize which Delphi applications to modernize first, balancing business risk, technical complexity, and ongoing support burden.
* Write clean, maintainable C\# code and apply Azure security and identity best practices (Managed Identity, Key Vault\-based secrets management) in all newly built services.
* Validate data integrity and business logic parity between legacy Delphi applications and their modernized Azure replacements.
* Partner with Architecture, Data Engineering, and Security teams to align modernization work with target\-state cloud architecture and HIPAA/HITRUST\-aligned controls.
* Document legacy application behavior, data flows, and business rules discovered during modernization to preserve institutional knowledge as Delphi systems are retired.
* Support and troubleshoot Oracle and SQL Server dependencies shared between legacy Delphi applications and their modernized replacements during transition periods.
* Performs other job\-related duties as required or assigned.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrated experience maintaining and developing in Delphi (desktop and/or web\-based applications).
* Strong C\# development experience, including building and deploying Azure\-native services (Function Apps, App Services).
* Working knowledge of Azure cloud services relevant to application modernization, including Storage Accounts, Managed Identity, and Key Vault.
* Experience working with both Oracle and SQL Server databases.
* Proven ability to reverse\-engineer and document legacy application logic and data flows in order to replicate them in a modern architecture.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the judgment to balance legacy system stability against the pace of modernization work.
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to document technical findings and migration plans for other engineers and IT leadership.
* Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.


**Education/Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* A minimum of three years of experience developing or maintaining Delphi applications.
* A minimum of two years of experience building applications or services in C\# on Azure preferred.
* Experience modernizing or re\-platforming legacy applications to a cloud\-native architecture strongly preferred.
* Experience in healthcare, health plan, or other regulated, data\-sensitive environments preferred.
* Familiarity with Oracle and SQL Server database development and administration preferred.

 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

**Position Purpose**
 The Data Scientist is responsible for supporting data science initiatives that drive business profitability, increased efficiencies and improved customer experience. This role applies industry\-leading analytical methodologies for working with large datasets to extract meaningful business insight and creatively solve business problems. Data Scientists are also responsible for ensuring that developed codes are documented into a library of reusable algorithms. Based on the specific data science team, this role would need to be knowledgeable in one or more data science specializations, such as optimization, computer vision, recommendation, search or NLP.
   

  

 As a Data Scientist, you will apply advanced analytics methods and algorithms for identifying trends and providing business solutions. This role is expected to present insights and recommendations to non\-technical audiences and explain the benefits and impacts of the recommended solutions. In addition, Data Scientists collaborate with business partners and cross\-functional teams, requiring effective communication skills, building relationships, and focus on understanding the overall business area being supported.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 55% Solution Development \- Design and develop algorithms and models to use against large datasets to create business insights; Participates in large data analytics project teams by serving as a technical lead for analytics projects; May lead small projects and work independently on solution development; Execute tasks with high levels of efficiency and quality; Make appropriate selection, utilization and interpretation of advanced analytical methodologies

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects
