 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

 (General Docker knowledge is expected).

 Terzo builds an AI\-native enterprise data platform designed to power the commercial and financial operating system of modern companies. Terzo sits at the intersection of data platforms, AI systems, and enterprise software, focusing on real production use cases rather than demos or point solutions.
 



  




 The Opportunity
 
 Terzo is building the AI platform layer that sits between structured enterprise intelligence and the people who act on it. The Financial Intelligence Graph gives our customers visibility into contracts, vendors, spend, obligations, and risk. The Agent Platform is how that intelligence becomes autonomous by powering AI agents, workflows, recommendations, and search experiences that move enterprise teams from insight to action without waiting on a human in the loop.
 



 As a Sr/Staff Engineer on the Agent Platform team, you will design and build the core infrastructure that makes this possible. You will own the platform APIs, orchestration layers, and runtime systems that power Terzo's AI agents, NirvanAI search, and the marketplace where customers deploy autonomous intelligence against their most critical commercial data. The services you build will be the substrate every AI\-powered experience at Terzo runs on.

 * 5\+ years building backend systems or developer platforms in distributed, cloud\-native environments
* Experience building platforms where AI capabilities are first\-class primitives, not bolted\-on features
* Strong API design instincts for services processing highly sensitive enterprise data
* Solid understanding of relational and non\-relational data stores, data modeling, and performance optimization
* Strong backend development especially Python
* Comfortable making architectural decisions with incomplete information
* Strong product intuition where you understand
 *why* 
 something is being built, not just how
* High ownership mentality where you treat system reliability and customer outcomes as your responsibility

* Exposure to graph databases, knowledge graph systems, or commercial ontology modeling

* Prior work at a high\-growth startup where you built platform foundations other teams shipped on top of

 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

 We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next\-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee\-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.
   

  

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

**Primary Role:**
 The Applied Data Scientist – AI Enablement is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on building internal AI capabilities and removing systemic constraints that limit HDR’s ability to scale artificial intelligence across the Transportation Business Group. In the initial phase, this role is primarily internally focused, developing AI solutions, improving data and technology foundations, and identifying bottlenecks in systems, processes, and tooling. As internal capabilities mature, the role will progressively transition to client\-facing AI delivery and advisory work, leveraging internally proven solutions as repeatable services.
   

  

**Utilization Expectations:**
* 40% Internal AI solution development
* 40% Client AI delivery and pilot engagements (as capabilities mature) (0% year 1\)
* 20% Skill development and continuous learning


**Primary Responsibilities:**
 Internal AI Capability Development:
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions addressing internal transportation business needs (e.g., document intelligence, predictive analytics, copilots, workflow automation).
* Build reusable AI components, data pipelines, and workflows that can be scaled for future client delivery
* Manage full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and inference.


 Constraint \& Bottleneck Identification:
   

  

* Proactively identify limitations in data availability, system integration, tooling, governance, and processes that inhibit AI adoption.
* Partner with IT, data architects, and business stakeholders to recommend scalable improvements.
* Document technical debt and architectural gaps that must be addressed before scaling AI capacity.


 Collaboration \& Communication:
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into structured AI solutions.
* Communicate AI concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Future Client\-Facing Work:
   

  

* Support client pursuits and pilot projects using internally developed AI capabilities.
* Contribute to the evolution of repeatable AI services and offerings.


 Note: This is not an exhaustive list. This role requires flexibility to perform other duties as required.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a closely related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with generative AI and modern AI services.
* Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining data and AI solutions in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP), including cloud\-native data pipelines, scalable compute, and production model deployment.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end data science projects and model lifecycles.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Advanced Degree
* Experience designing or improving data pipelines and AI infrastructure.
* Consulting or professional services experience.
* Six Sigma or other process improvement certifications.


**Required Qualifications**
* A degree in a closely related field or combination of education and relevant experience
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Power Query, and Pandas
* A minimum of 3 years experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, Seaborn, and Matplotlib
* A minimum of 3 years experience with data science languages such as Python and R
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional, ability to multitask a must
* Proficiency with MS Office including Word and Outlook
* Ability to handle confidential information
* Excellent writing and people skills
* Strong math and organizational skills
* Flexibility and ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and various managers in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including grammar, punctuation, proofreading, spelling and telephone skills
* An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee\-owned culture is a must
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and data analytics
* Experience completing multiple data science projects

**Senior Python Developer** 




**12\+ Months W2 Contract** 




**Hybrid\-in office 3 days/week in St. Louis, MO** 




**Rate $75\-80/hr on W2** 




  





**Job Description:** 




 Day\-to\-day:
 



 Lead the design and development of an enterprise AI platform that enables agentic workflows across structured and unstructured data. This hands\-on role combines software development, platform architecture, AI strategy, and technical leadership to build scalable AI solutions and guide key technology decisions.
 



 3 must\-have skills: experience w/ production agentic systems. implementing, monitoring, and evaluating those systems.
 



 Nice\-to\-have skills: If they have worked with Agent Bricks in any meaningful capacity. Working with LangGraph. Self\-motivated and willing to help other teammates. Not looking for someone who just wants to "shut up and code"
 



 Extend or convert: Conversion is the goal, but the fit needs to be right and the work needs to be good.
 



 Interview process: Virtual first round and then in\-person in the second round.
 



 Arrangements: Hybrid 3 days in office, 1 of the three days needs to be a Monday or Friday.
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to design, build, and operate enterprise AI solutions. You will help evolve our platform from Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications to agentic AI systems that leverage reasoning, orchestration, tool use, and autonomous workflows.
 



  





 You will work closely with platform engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to build scalable, reliable, and measurable AI solutions. A key part of the role is ensuring AI systems can be evaluated, monitored, and operated successfully in production.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




 · Design, build, deploy, and support production AI solutions.
 



 · Develop agentic workflows, tool integrations, and orchestration pipelines.
 



 · Build and evolve RAG and agent\-based architectures.
 



 · Create evaluation frameworks to improve quality, groundedness, and reliability.
 



 · Implement AI observability, tracing, and monitoring capabilities.
 



 · Develop automated testing and regression validation processes.
 



 · Integrate AI solutions with APIs, enterprise applications, and data sources. Design reusable AI patterns, frameworks, and components that increase platform scalability and team productivity.
 



 · Establish engineering best practices and contribute to code reviews.
 



 · Research and adopt emerging AI technologies where they provide business value.
 



 · Partner with stakeholders to translate business problems into AI solutions
 



  





**Required Skills** 




 · 5\+ years of software engineering experience.
 



 · Proven track record of delivering enterprise\-grade production software.
 



 · Strong Python development skills.
 



 · Experience building, deploying, and operating production AI systems.
 



 · Experience designing and implementing RAG solutions.
 



 · Experience with Databricks.
 



 · Hands\-on experience with LangGraph or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
 



 · Experience building AI workflows that leverage tools, APIs, and external systems.
 



 · Experience with AI evaluation frameworks and quality measurement.
 



 · Experience implementing AI observability and tracing solutions.
 



 · Understanding of agent architecture patterns, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation techniques.
 



 · Experience with AWS in production environments.
 



 · Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
 



 · Experience with Git, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.
 



 · Knowledge of secure coding principles and responsible AI practices.
 



 · Experience collaborating within Agile software development teams
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 · Experience with AgentBricks.
 



 · Experience with Microsoft Copilot extensibility and agent development.
 



 · Experience with LangChain and related frameworks.
 



 · Experience with MCP integrations.
 



 · Experience with vector databases and semantic search.
 



 · Experience with AWS Bedrock.
 



 · Experience with OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Grafana, MLflow, DeepEval, or similar tooling.
 



 · Experience deploying multi\-agent systems.
 



 · Experience with Terraform.
 



 · AWS, Databricks, Microsoft, or AI\-related certifications.
 



**Mindset** 




 · Delivers AI solutions that create measurable business value.
 



 · Treats evaluation and observability as first\-class engineering disciplines.
 



 · Balances innovation with reliability, scalability, and governance.
 



 · Takes ownership of production systems and outcomes.
 



 · Thinks holistically about data, architecture, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
 



 · Collaborates effectively across technical and business teams.
 



 · Continuously learns and adapts to evolving AI technologies.
